mapper.select: SELECT * FROM direct_sale ORDER BY seq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO direct_sale (seq, name, description, product_name, image_url, price, created_at, seller_seq, category_seq, trade_location_seq) VALUES (direct_sale_seq.nextval, #{name}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productName}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, SYSDATE, #{sellerSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{tradeLocationSeq})
